class.name: BulletSpawner2D
class.brief_description: Fires timed volleys of directional bullets through a [BulletFactory2D].
class.description: Assign a [BulletFactory2D], a [DirectionalBulletsData2D], and a [member transforms_source]. Each volley collects one global transform per bullet from the [member transforms_generator] and spawns it through the factory. It never fires in the editor. Homing quick-start: turn on [member homing_enabled], leave [member homing_target_source] on Node Group, and put your player (any Node2D) in the [member homing_node_group] group. Every volley then chases [member homing_target_selection] targets with [member homing_smoothing] turn rate. Set [member homing_target_source] to Mouse to chase the cursor instead, and turn on [member orbiting_enabled] to make bullets ring their target once they arrive. Use [member homing_retarget_mode] so flying volleys keep following fresh targets, and [signal volley_bullet_homing_target_reached] to react when a bullet arrives.

method.name: collect_spawn_transforms
method.description: Returns one global transform per bullet for the current [member transforms_source]. Empty [member transforms_generator] means this node. Children mode with no markers falls back to the generator itself. Aimed mode with no target returns an empty array.

method.name: get_bullet_factory
method.description: Returns the factory from [member bullet_factory_path], or null when unset or invalid.

method.name: get_transforms_generator
method.description: Returns the assigned generator, or null when unset. Use [method get_effective_generator] when you need the fallback included.

method.name: get_effective_generator
method.description: Returns the node patterns are built on: the assigned generator, or this spawner when unset or invalid. Never null in the tree.

method.name: get_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Returns the aimed-mode target, or null when unset.

method.name: get_spin_angle_deg
method.description: Current spin angle in degrees. Only advances at runtime while [member spin_enabled] is on.

method.name: get_volleys_fired
method.description: Volleys fired since the last (re)arm. Reset with [method reset_shooting].

method.name: is_spinning
method.description: Returns true when [member spin_enabled] is on and the game is running.

method.name: reset_shooting
method.description: Resets the volley counter and restarts the timer with [member shoot_initial_delay_sec].

method.name: set_bullet_factory
method.description: Assigns the factory directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: set_transforms_generator
method.description: Assigns the generator directly. Pass null to use this spawner instead. Takes effect right away, in the editor and at runtime.

method.name: set_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Assigns the aimed-mode target directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: start_spinning
method.description: Turns [member spin_enabled] on.

method.name: stop_spinning
method.description: Turns [member spin_enabled] off, freezing the angle.

method.name: reset_spin_angle
method.description: Resets the spin angle to zero.

method.name: shoot_once
method.description: Fires one volley now. Returns false when misconfigured or the factory refuses it. Counts toward [member max_volleys]. Safe to call from _physics_process (same-shape pool reuse applies immediately; only a shape-type change waits for a safe point). Must not be called re-entrantly from inside spawner signal handlers (homing_targets_resolved, volley_homing_configured, volley_fired, shooting_finished): nested calls are rejected, use [method shoot_once_deferred] (or call_deferred("shoot_once")) instead. If a handler frees or re-homes the volley mid-setup, the shot is safely dropped (returns false) instead of emitting volley_fired with a dead instance.

method.name: shoot_once_deferred
method.description: Queues a [method shoot_once] with call_deferred so it runs after the current emission / physics step instead of nesting. Use this from spawner signal handlers or colliding contexts. Returns false when the spawner is not inside the tree.

method.name: resolve_homing_targets
method.description: Resolves the current homing targets without touching any volley: group members, name matches (case-insensitive unless [member homing_node_name_case_sensitive]), children of the parent path, the node at [member homing_target_path], or the [member homing_global_position] snapshot. The Mouse source returns an empty array (the cursor is pushed live, not resolved). Entries are Node2D or Vector2. Unless quiet is true, an empty result warns once until a resolution succeeds again. With advance_round_robin off, the round-robin pick is resolved without consuming the cursor (retarget passes use this so flying volleys keep stable targets).

method.name: retarget_live_volleys
method.description: Re-resolves targets and replaces the queues of every still-active volley owned by this spawner (expired or pooled volleys are skipped), and re-applies steering and orbiting tuning so runtime changes reach flying volleys. Random and round-robin selections resolve per volley. Volleys with no resolvable targets are skipped quietly and keep their old queues. Returns how many volleys were retargeted. Also runs automatically when [member homing_retarget_mode] is On Interval. Only the newest volley is touched when [member homing_retarget_previous_volleys] is off.

method.name: get_live_volley_count
method.description: How many spawned volleys are currently tracked for retargeting.

method.name: get_live_volleys
method.description: The tracked live volley instances (pruned first), so scripts can call the full DirectionalBullets2D API on each volley directly.

method.name: clear_live_volleys
method.description: Forgets all tracked volleys. They keep flying untouched and are no longer retargeted. Reached-signal forwarding stays connected. Tracking is also capped at the 256 most recent volleys (oldest dropped first), so long auto-shoot sessions with infinite lifetimes cannot grow retarget cost without bound.

method.name: adopt_live_volley
method.description: Takes ownership of a manually-woken volley (manual wake detaches the previous owner): stamps it, replaces any surviving reached forwarder with its own, and tracks it for retargeting. Queues are left alone. Returns false for null or non-live instances.

method.name: clear_live_volleys_homing
method.description: Kill-switch: clears homing queues and stops orbiting on every tracked live volley, through engine clears that keep all counters exact. Returns how many volleys were touched. Retargeting re-arms them while homing stays on; turn homing off (or clear tracking) to keep them flying straight.

method.name: override_live_volleys_velocity
method.description: Overwrites velocity on every tracked live volley (wind, knockback). A speed curve overrides direct velocity, so this visibly works only for curve-free volleys. Returns how many volleys were touched. Must be finite.

members.member: Path to the [BulletFactory2D] used for spawning.
Auto-shooting stops after this many volleys. -1 is infinite, 0 disables auto-shooting ([method shoot_once] still works).
Delay before the first volley after (re)arming.
Seconds between automatic volleys. Must be above zero.
Master switch for automatic shooting. [method shoot_once] works regardless.
Bullet data for each volley. Duplicated per volley, so sharing one resource is safe.
Node patterns are built on. Empty means this spawner. Point it at another Node2D to move children markers, helper shapes, spin pivot, scale center, and the preview there.
Scales the whole pattern around the generator. 1.0 keeps it as is, 0 collapses it onto the generator, negatives mirror it.

Flat global offset added to every bullet right after spawn (muzzle offsets, spawn-then-nudge). Zero disables the pass. Applied through the engine teleport path, so shapes, attachments, and interpolation stay in sync. Must be finite.
Rotates each volley around the generator at runtime. Editor preview stays still.
Spin speed in continuous mode. Positive is clockwise.
0 rotates forever, 1 swings back and forth (see amplitude and frequency).
How far the pattern swings each way in oscillate mode.
Swings per second in oscillate mode.
Where volley transforms come from: children markers, this generator itself, or a procedural helper pattern. Only the active pattern's options show in the inspector.
Bullet count for helper patterns. Clamped to 1-10000: one volley fans out to transforms, instance buffers and physics shapes, so uncapped values would freeze on a typo.
Grid rows per column.
Grid anchor, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.Alignment].
Grid horizontal spacing.
Grid vertical spacing.
Rotate the grid with the generator.
Give each grid bullet a random facing.
Random position offset per grid bullet. 0 is off.
Ring radius around the generator.
Angle in radians where the ring starts.
Ring length in radians. Full circle by default.
Rotate the ring with the generator.
Give each ring bullet a random facing.
Face bullets away from the center. Off faces them inward.
Squashes the ring into an ellipse. 1.0 is a circle.
Twists every ring facing by this many degrees.
Fan width in radians.
Fan center direction in radians.
Spacing between fan origins so bullets do not stack.
Center the fan on its direction. Off starts it to one side.
Radius of the first spiral bullet.
Radius growth per spiral bullet.
Angle step in radians per spiral bullet.
Rotate the spiral with the generator.
Spiral facing, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.SpiralFacingMode].
Twists every spiral facing by this many degrees.
Line axis. Does not need to be normalized.
Distance between line bullets.
Face line bullets along the line. Off keeps the generator facing.
Where the generator sits on the line, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.LineAnchor].
Face line bullets across the line. Needs [member helper_line_face_direction].
Node the aimed cone points at. No target means no bullets.
Aimed cone width in radians.
Spacing between aimed origins so bullets do not stack.
Center the cone on the target. Off starts it to one side.
Shows one dot and facing arrow per bullet in the editor. Follows the generator live. Never saved to the scene.
Also shows the preview while the game runs. Off by default.
Preview dot color.
Preview arrow color.
Preview dot radius in pixels.
Gap in pixels between dot edge and arrow tail.
Preview arrow length in pixels.
Preview arrow shaft width in pixels.
Preview arrow head length in pixels.
Preview arrow head width in pixels.
Master switch: every volley chases the configured targets. Off means volleys fly exactly as the spawn data says.
0 shares one target queue across the whole volley, 1 gives every bullet its own queue (same targets each).

Where volley targets come from: a node group, the mouse cursor, a global position snapshot, a node path, a node name, or a node's children. Each source shows its own settings, like the transforms_source helper patterns do.
Polled group for the Node Group source. Only Node2D members can be chased, the rest are skipped.
Extra allow-list on top of any source: only targets also in this group are kept. Empty means no filtering.
Which detected nodes become targets: nearest to the spawner, random, tree order, round robin across volleys, or dealt across bullets (Per Bullet mode only).
How many targets enter the queue. 1 is classic single-target homing. Only the node group, node name, and node children sources use it.
Detection radius around the spawner for the node group, node name, and node children sources. 0 is unlimited.
Position chased per volley for the Global Position source. Must be finite.
Node chased per volley for the Node Path source. Must point at a live Node2D, otherwise the volley flies without homing.
Name pattern chased for the Node Name source. The whole scene is scanned, so dynamically spawned enemies are found with no group setup. The spawner itself never matches.
How the node name source compares names: exact, contains, starts with, or ends with.
Compares node names strictly. Off (default) matches "Player" against "PlAyEr".
Parent whose Node2D children are chased for the Node Children source. Required: empty or invalid paths fly without homing.
Includes grandchildren and deeper descendants for the Node Children source.
Max turn rate in radians per second. 0 snaps instantly.
Seconds between target position refreshes. 0 refreshes every tick.
A target counts as reached inside this distance. Predictive, so fast bullets still trigger.
Lets homing steer the bullet facing. Turn off only when a movement pattern, rotation data, or orbiting texture mode already owns the facing, otherwise homing steers nothing.
Mirrors DirectionalBulletsData2D adjust_direction_based_on_rotation per volley: bullet directions follow their rotation data. Applied with the steering block while homing is on.
Advances per-bullet queues when a target is reached. Only used in Per Bullet mode.
Advances the shared queue when a target is reached. Only used in Shared mode.
Fans smoothing out per bullet: bullet i steers with start + step times i.
Per-bullet smoothing of the first bullet.
Per-bullet smoothing growth per bullet. May be negative, results clamp at 0.
0 leaves flying volleys alone, On Interval re-resolves and replaces their queues every interval. On by default so group, name, and children tracking stays live as members spawn and die.
Seconds between automatic retarget passes. Must be above zero.
Retargeting re-aims every tracked live volley. Turn off to re-aim only the newest volley, letting older ones fly at whatever they chased last.
Prints resolved target count and first target per homing volley. Use it when bullets fly straight unexpectedly.
Bullets ring their homing target once they arrive. Needs [member homing_enabled]: orbiting without a homing target does nothing.
Orbit ring radius in pixels. Must be at least 0.01.
Orbit direction. Dont Move keeps the course (orbiting is skipped with a warning).
How bullet textures face while physically orbiting.
Fans the radius out per bullet: bullet i orbits with start + step times i (concentric shells).
Orbit radius of the first bullet in linear mode.
Orbit radius growth per bullet in linear mode. May be negative, results clamp at 0.01.

signal.name: area_entered
signal.description: Fired when one of this spawner's bullets enters an area.

signal.name: body_entered
signal.description: Fired when one of this spawner's bullets hits a body.

signal.name: life_time_over
signal.description: Fired when this spawner's bullets expire. Needs the lifetime signal enabled in the bullet data.

signal.name: shooting_finished
signal.description: Fired when the volley counter reaches [member max_volleys].

signal.name: shooting_started
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns on.

signal.name: shooting_stopped
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns off via [member shooting_enabled].

signal.name: volley_fired
signal.description: Fired for every volley, with a 1-based counter.

signal.name: volley_homing_configured
signal.description: Fired for every homing/orbiting volley right after it is configured, before [signal volley_fired]. Only fires when homing or orbiting is enabled.

signal.name: homing_targets_resolved
signal.description: Fired per volley with the resolved targets (Node2D or Vector2 entries). Empty for the Mouse source and for volleys that found nothing.

signal.name: volley_bullet_homing_target_reached
signal.description: Forwarded from the volley instance when one of its bullets reaches its homing target. Target is null for position and mouse targets, and for freed nodes. Note: pool reuse clears all handlers on the instance, so connect here on the spawner instead of on volley instances directly.
